concept.name: firefox_decodertraits_pref_gate_20260629
concept.human_rationale: Gated DecoderTraits.cpp hardware-only format/container blocks behind a custom preference: "media.gorilla.hardware_only_mode" (default: true). This provides an immediate escape hatch in about:config to disable zero-CPU constraints and re-enable VP8/VP9/AV1 software decoding if a website lacks H.264 fallback, avoiding the need to recompile.
concept.execution_logic:
1. Defined the preference in StaticPrefList.yaml: ```yaml # Enforce hardware-only H.264 playback policy and block VP8/VP9/AV1 - name: media.gorilla.hardware_only_mode type: RelaxedAtomicBool value: true mirror: always ```
2. Wrapped container and codec blocks in DecoderTraits.cpp: - Included header: `#include "mozilla/StaticPrefs_media.h"` - Inside CanHandleCodecsType (codec checks): ```cpp if (StaticPrefs::media_gorilla_hardware_only_mode() && (aType.OriginalString().Find("av01") != -1 || aType.OriginalString().Find("vp9") != -1 || // ... (other codecs) ...)) { return CANPLAY_NO; } ``` - Inside CanHandleMediaType (container checks): ```cpp if (StaticPrefs::media_gorilla_hardware_only_mode() && (OggDecoder::IsSupportedType(mimeType) || WebMDecoder::IsSupportedType(mimeType))) { return CANPLAY_NO; } ```
Modified files: - patches/modules/libpref/init/StaticPrefList.yaml - patches/dom/media/DecoderTraits.cpp - patches/01_Media_Audio_Video/DecoderTraits.cpp
